cases.title: FM services EMEA — defined category, geography, must-haves, target longlist size

inputs.category: Integrated facilities management — cleaning, security, catering

pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH or MEDIUM
longlist contains at least 8 candidates with individual fit rationale
each candidate record includes: name, fit evidence, geography coverage, and confidence note
source_quality populated — method and coverage noted
data_gaps is empty or contains only non-blocking items
no candidate presented as confirmed fit without stated evidence

cases.title: Category name only — no geography, no criteria, no target size
pass_signals: status is blocked
confidence_level is INSUFFICIENT_DATA or LOW
data_gaps includes: geography not specified, qualification criteria not defined
skill does not produce a longlist without at minimum geography and at least one must-have criterion
open_questions contains at least: geography, must-have criteria, target longlist size

cases.title: Must-have criteria include two mutually exclusive certification standards

must_have_criteria: NEN 3140 certified (Dutch electrical safety standard — incompatible scope with NICEIC)

pass_signals: conflict between NICEIC (UK) and NEN 3140 (Dutch) certification requirements is explicitly surfaced
skill does not apply both criteria simultaneously without flagging the contradiction
open_questions contains: certification conflict — which standard takes precedence?
confidence_level is MEDIUM or LOW while contradiction is unresolved
no final longlist issued until criteria conflict is resolved

cases.title: Fewer than 3 candidates identified meeting all must-have criteria

inputs.search_results_note: Only 2 suppliers identified meeting all three must-haves after exhaustive search

pass_signals: risk_flags contains: fewer than 3 candidates meet all must-have criteria — concentration risk
escalation_required is true
skill does not present a 2-candidate longlist as market-complete without flagging the thin result
open_questions contains: review must-have criteria for feasibility?, consider geographic expansion?
confidence_level is LOW or MEDIUM — limited market coverage acknowledged
data_gaps includes: market alternatives not independently confirmed as exhausted
